families.notes: A user-token launchpad, not a pump-and-pull operator: no operator buy, no decoys, no crowd, liquidity never removed, nobody but the dust bot touches the pools. The strict family is one launch contract's 6 launches of 772-byte metadata; families 0xcd1e2cbe, 0x80521fc9 and 0xd912ed6c are the same launcher in three consecutive hours. The whole imortal.buzz launcher (selector 7fde822e: 490 census pools in 48 h = 245/day, 27 launch contracts of 19,028 bytes, each used for exactly 20 launches then replaced; 5 deployers, 454 pools by 0x06cb3a68) is the same: first buy in 490/490 pools is the dust bot's 2e-6 ETH at +3, a buy >= 0.0002 ETH in only 5/490 (+3, +843, +959, +1510, +1625; 5 different wallets and routers), and the platform address 0x94dddbb5 (calldata words 7/9) sells ~98% of each such buy's ETH back into the pool 2-18 blocks later (5 of 5, delays 2, 3, 12, 13, 18; via 0xfa9b5811 bbb2e1a6 / 0x2fe63b82 c4427054): a back-run, not a pull; 0 pulls within 3,000 blocks in all 490; front n 490, mean -2.06%, median -2.06%, win 0%, pulled-first 0, $-0.309 a trade, $-75.69 a day; follow n 5, mean -2.53%, median -2.25%, win 0%, pulled-first 0, $-0.379 a trade, $-0.95 a day. Break-even: the pools are shallow (virtual ETH depth 1.33 ETH), so any buy >= 0.0142 ETH behind our 0.0058 would pay, but none is scheduled. Method check (same code, analyse.py controls): v2.433 front (buy launch+1, sell one block after the bot's first c1120e3d router buy, else +20) n 1843, mean +11.86%, median +14.01%, win 95%, pulled-first 0, $+1.779 a trade, $+1639.55 a day on all 1,843 census v2.433 pools and n 410, mean +13.95%, median +16.17%, win 99%, pulled-first 0, $+2.092 a trade, $+429.05 a day on the Oct 10 live window (410 pools; HANDOFF: +13.97%); our 1,080 real relay trades re-priced at their own B/S/stake: model mean +8.71% vs realised +8.74%, all 1,080 within 0.5 pt (median |diff| 3e-16); operator A follow n 75, mean +4.34%, median +3.27%, win 84%, pulled-first 0, $+0.650 a trade, $+24.40 a day; v2.433 capacity from the bot's real minOut (word 4) 0.0124 ETH ahead of a 0.05 ETH buy (HANDOFF 6.8: 0.0122-0.0124); gas 2 x 104,000 x the launch block base fee (0.020 gwei) = $0.0108 a trade.
